caption: The drawing is a black-and-white sketch of a symmetrical building facade that resembles the front of a mission-style church. The structure features a triangular pediment at the top, with a small round window at its center and a cross mounted on a pedestal above the peak. Below the pediment are two rectangular windows, one on each side, with decorative frames. Beneath these windows is a large central arched doorway, supported by two columns, with the year "1822" inscribed above the arch and again displayed on a banner to the left. The front is composed of what appears to be stone blocks, indicated by line work. Flanking both sides of the building are simple pilasters, and at the base, there is a shadow suggesting depth. Below the building, another ribbon-shaped banner contains the text “Misión Nuestra Señora la Reina de Los Angeles” written in plain script. The entire composition is rendered in shades of gray and black, giving it a monochrome appearance, and is set against an off-white background.
title: Mision Nuestra Senora La Reina de Los Angeles
